modules.title: Module 1: LangChain Fundamentals
modules.description: This module introduces the core concepts of LangChain, covering its purpose, installation, and basic usage to get you started.

topics.description: Understand what LangChain is, its primary goals, and how it simplifies the development of applications powered by large language models.
Learn the step-by-step process of installing LangChain and setting up your development environment to begin building applications.
Explore the fundamental steps to interact with LangChain, including basic prompts and simple chain executions.

modules.title: Module 2: Understanding LangChain's Core APIs and Chains
modules.description: Dive deeper into the essential building blocks of LangChain, focusing on its API structure and key chain types like LLMChain and APIChain.

topics.description: Familiarize yourself with the general structure, common patterns, and key components of LangChain's programmatic interface.
Understand LLMChain, a foundational chain for orchestrating interactions with Large Language Models, including prompt templating and output parsing.
Learn how APIChain enables LangChain to interact with external APIs, allowing your LLM applications to fetch and process real-world data.

modules.title: Module 3: Practical Application and Examples
modules.description: This module focuses on applying your knowledge through practical examples and encourages building simple LangChain applications to solidify your understanding.

topics.description: Analyze and run various provided LangChain examples to see how different components are combined to solve specific problems.
Apply the concepts learned to construct your own basic LangChain applications, integrating LLMs with other tools and data sources.
